# ExecutionPlanBuilder

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Query.Planning.ExecutionPlanBuilder`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Query`

## Summary

Builds an execution plan from a ScriptDom Microsoft.SqlServer.TransactSql.ScriptDom.TSqlFragment AST. Walks the ScriptDom AST directly and constructs an PPDS.Dataverse.Query.Planning.IQueryPlanNode tree that the existing plan executor expects.
